title: Exactly one post-answer next action — never a stack of CTAs
input: Compare your plans and also tell me about demos and the free tools.
note: Spec §3/§13.3 — 'one useful next action is usually enough'; the runner counts CTA-bearing components (action_confirmation, slot_picker, support_case_preview, or any component carrying ctaRoute) and caps at 1. Full WCAG 2.2 AA review stays a browser-level gate outside this runner.
